## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking, ungainly man with kindly brown eyes. He has stooping shoulders touched by long, iron-gray hair, and sports a full, soft brown beard that he has worn since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Matthew Cuthbert is an exceptionally quiet, shy, and unobservant man who hates going among strangers or speaking in public. He harbors a deep dread of women—feeling they secretly laugh at him—and has traditionally felt a mortal dread of little girls, while new acquaintances like a new minister's wife terrify him. Despite his quiet nature, he is a sympathetic listener who enjoys talkative people willing to converse for him. He is also hard-working, patient, wise, and does not seek out excitement. Though argument is not his strong point, he is remarkably persistent and holds fast to his opinions once he takes a whim into his head.

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with his sister, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Though they originally intended to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, Matthew went to the [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station and was surprised to find [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), a young orphan girl, waiting for him instead. Matthew was quickly charmed by her imaginative chatter and quietly advocated for keeping her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Over the years, he offered her warmth, encouragement, and gifts, such as chocolates and a calf bought from Mr. Bell. He also secretly convinced her to apologize to Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to end a punishment and advocated for her to attend a local concert. Seeing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lacked stylish clothes, Matthew arranged with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to secretly procure a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas). Later, Matthew and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agreed to support [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joining an advanced class to prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the exam, she ran to the field to share her triumph with Matthew and her family. Matthew attended Anne's commencement at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) when she won the Avery scholarship.

## Quotes

> "I reckon she ought to be punished a little. But don’t be too hard on her, Marilla. Recollect she hasn’t ever had anyone to teach her right. You’re—you’re going to give her something to eat, aren’t you?"
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003)

> "It’ll have to be done sooner or later, you know, for Marilla’s a dreadful determined woman—dreadful determined, Anne. Do it right off, I say, and have it over."
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)

> "That’s right—that’s right, Anne. But don’t tell Marilla I said anything about it. She might think I was putting my oar in and I promised not to do that."
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019)

> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P25](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0025)

>

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are the best of friends. After bringing her home by mistake instead of a boy, Matthew quietly advocates for keeping her when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) wants to send her back. He offers her quiet support and sweet gifts, such as chocolates, and secretly intervenes to gently persuade her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can be freed from her punishment.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +14 more_

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are siblings who live together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) manages the household and takes the lead on disciplining and educating [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Matthew offers a quieter presence and subtly sways decisions in Anne's favor, such as suggesting they keep her when she first arrives. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) frequently confides in Matthew about her frustrations and plans regarding Anne's upbringing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), +30 more_
